observed: English dialogue starts at game canvas origin instead of the lower dialogue area.
Speaker name overlaps dialogue at the top.
Dialogue panel and speaker nameplate are absent; advance indicator remains at bottom right.
user_confirmation: First classroom line is also broken; Select Difficulty displays normally.
root_cause: The ADV control-code scan accepts UTF-16 values <=125, including NUL. English after a formatting marker allows it to scan past the input and overwrite dialogue/name/window state.
fix: Use fullwidth Latin codepoints immediately after formatting controls; both fonts render identical ASCII glyphs and the kerning table supplies identical advances. Controls, IDs and voices are preserved.
regression_checks: All emitted scenario controls stop before NUL; speaker/message lengths stay below native buffer limits. Font glyph and kerning equality verified.
remaining_issue: English first line clips at the right edge in 0.1.6; font conversion and pixel-width reflow included in 0.1.7.
